name: detent-dial
title: Detent Dial
description: A circular temperature dial with a ring of ticks around a large knob. Turning it snaps from notch to notch, flicks coast and settle, and the big readout rolls its digits as the value changes.
use: A single numeric setting such as temperature or volume deserves a precise, tactile dial instead of a plain range slider.
avoid: It needs a wide square area and captures touch, so it is awkward in tight mobile layouts or long scrolling forms.
a11y: Slider role, keyboard steps, aria values and a reduced-motion path are all covered; only the tiny end labels are hidden from screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: On a black stage, a large dark circular knob with a thin rim and a short white indicator line sits inside a 270-degree ring of radial ticks, one glowing orange at the current value. Inside the knob Temperature sits above a big white readout, with 16.0° and 30.0° at the lower corners.
behaves: Dragging around the knob turns the value, snapping toward each notch and coasting briefly after a flick before settling. Scroll-wheel and arrow keys step it, double-click returns to the default, and the readout's digits roll over as the number changes.
customise: Label, min, max, step, value/defaultValue, size and a formatValue function all come from props; the tick colours and indicator styling need source edits.
weight: light: An SVG tick ring and motion transforms on a single knob; idle when untouched.
demo: Reads 'Temperature' with values like 21.0° and 24.5°, and end labels 16.0° and 30.0°.
issues: The 16.0° and 30.0° end labels are small and low-contrast against the black stage.
polishWhy: Refined instrument feel with a travelling tick wave and rolling digits; end labels are faint.
